findings.issue: The `cn` utility incorrectly passes the entire `inputs` array as a single argument to `clsx`. `clsx` expects a variadic list of class values, so the current implementation results in nested arrays and incorrect class name merging.

The DO block that creates RLS policies for storage buckets is syntactically incomplete – it ends abruptly inside the `execute format(...)` call, missing the closing parentheses, the `END LOOP;`, and the final `END;`. This will cause the migration to fail when applied.
findings.fix:
Complete the DO block with proper syntax. Example corrected version:
```sql
DO $$
DECLARE
  bucket_id text;
BEGIN
  FOREACH bucket_id IN ARRAY ARRAY['campaign-inputs', 'presenters', 'voices', 'raw-video', 'rendered-video', 'thumbnails', 'subtitles', 'exports']
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format(
      'CREATE POLICY %I ON storage.objects FOR SELECT USING (bucket_id = %L AND (public.is_workspace_member_for_storage_path(name) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM storage.buckets b WHERE b.id = %L AND b.public)))',
      'ws_select_' || replace(bucket_id, '-', '_'),
      bucket_id,
      bucket_id
    );
  END LOOP;
END $$;
```
This adds the missing `END LOOP;` and `END $$;` and correctly constructs the policy name.
